title: AgentHeadResponse
description: 200 body of GET /api/v1/projects/{project_id}/agents/{agent_ref}/best-config-head?environment=<SessionEnvironment>: the promotion head of the agent in the environment. generation 0 with null best_config_id, best_config_version, promoted_by_run_id and updated_at means the agent was never promoted there. A run captures `generation` when it STARTS and sends it back as X-Traigent-Expected-Head-Generation when it publishes its own result; it is not a token to refresh and reuse for a result computed against an older head (see best_config_head_refusal_schema.json, head_generation_stale). The project is the path project, never X-Project-Id. Shape mirrors TraigentBackend serialize_head wrapped in the standard success envelope.

agent_id.description: The agent ref of the path, returned unchanged.

generation.description: Current head generation; 0 when never promoted. JSON-safe integer bound.

best_config_id.description: Server-issued id of the promoted best config; null when never promoted.

best_config_version.description: Promoted version; null when never promoted.

promoted_by_run_id.description: Server-issued id of the run that promoted the head; null when never promoted.

updated_at.description: When the head last moved; null when never promoted.
